items.title: Catalog home page tab title is "Catalog | AdventureWorks"
items.reason: This is the bug's acceptance criterion: opening the catalog must show "Catalog | AdventureWorks" instead of the bare "AdventureWorks". The tab title is only observable in a browser rendering the Blazor `<PageTitle>`, so the case runs at the e2e layer exactly as the Steps to Reproduce describe.

items.title: Catalog page content is unchanged by the title fix
covers: Expected: Nothing else on the page changes
items.reason: The Expected result states "Nothing else on the page changes"; the fix edits the same Razor file that renders the catalog header and product grid, so a slip there would break visible content. The checks use the seeded `default` catalog values the page showed before the fix, at the e2e layer because only the rendered page shows them.

items.title: Leaving the catalog for an item page does not keep the "Catalog | AdventureWorks" title
covers: Bug Report: every WebApp page's tab title names the page
Expected: Nothing else on the page changes
items.reason: The fix sets "Catalog | AdventureWorks" on the catalog only; the Bug Report states every other page's tab title names that page. This boundary case guards against the catalog title leaking past the catalog (for example a title set in the shared layout, or a Blazor `<PageTitle>` that is not replaced on client navigation), which would make the item page say "Catalog". It runs at e2e because the title only exists in the rendered browser document, and it starts on the catalog so the navigation leaves the fixed page.
